THE BLOCK IS THE WATANABE 2014 FINDING — 'Visibly more even, radiant tone, 2% GSSG (the exact active)': randomised, double-blind, split-face, placebo-controlled, 30 women aged 30-50, twice-daily 2% GSSG lotion for 10 weeks, significantly more even-looking tone versus placebo (reduced melanin index, p < 0.001), improved moisture and smoothness (p < 0.05).

MAGNITUDE MATCHES THE BLOCK THIS TIME, WHICH THE PREVIOUS TWO PICKS DID NOT. Slot b belongs to the f1 family and is going into the f1 block, so the brief's licensed magnitude — a clearly visible evening over ten weeks — is the one the copy claims. The f3 block currently carries slot d, also an f1-family frame; that mismatch is recorded in page-glutathione-research-f3-slot-d-publish.json.

VERIFIED AT 100%, NOT FROM THE CONTACT SHEET: the distinct mole on her cheek and the scattered freckles and sun spots across both cheeks are all present in the right panel, in the same places. What has changed is the diffuse reddish mottling across the nose and cheeks, which has calmed. Pores, fine expression lines and the nasolabial creases survive in both panels — no smoothing. Gaze differs plainly between the halves (eyes to her right in the later frame), head angle differs, garment differs, room differs. No baked-in text, no hand, no phone, no mirror.

MEASURED, AND THE FIRST METRIC USED ON THIS PAGE WAS THE WRONG ONE — RECORDED SO IT IS NOT REPEATED. Sampling skin-like pixels only and taking a single standard deviation of tone gives +4% on this frame and +5% on slot d, which reads as 'less even, not more'. That metric conflates two frequencies. Separating them with a 40px Gaussian:

    slot b   broad-tone SD 25.80 -> 25.01   (-3%)   all-detail SD +4%
    slot d   broad-tone SD 29.67 -> 26.53   (-11%)  all-detail SD +5%

The BROAD tone field — the large-scale mottling, which is what 'more even' actually claims — improves on both. The all-detail figure rises precisely BECAUSE the freckles are retained and now sit against calmer skin, so their local contrast goes up. Retention and evenness together are the intended result, and the naive metric penalised the pictures for succeeding. Mean skin luminance is +16.7 on this frame against +32.6 on slot d, so this pair is also the less exposure-confounded of the two.
